title: Irradiated maps that drop tablets
summary: Three Irradiated Tablets with waystone quantity and monster effectiveness, corrupted six-modifier Tier 15 waystones and Jado's Partial Translations: maps that drop Precursor Tablets of varying kinds and sustain their own waystones.

budget.why: Three Irradiated Tablets per map and Tier 15 waystones rolled to six modifiers and corrupted.
budget.build_needs: Clears corrupted six-modifier Tier 15 maps with stacked monster effectiveness.

claim.note: Our reading of the setup against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: Corrupted six-modifier waystones plus monster effectiveness on each of three tablets: difficulty that stacks as you push it.

claim.note: Our reading of the cited facts against the build scale; not measured.

complexity.why: Waystones are rolled and corrupted for every map, and the tablets the maps drop feed a second activity: rolling and selling them.

claim.note: Our reading of the strategy's own steps against the complexity scale; not measured.

durability.why_it_works: Tablets of one type suppress drops of that type; Irradiated Tablets suppress none, and monster effectiveness plus waystone quantity raise tablet drops. Mountain Mastery's Tablets bonus adds 50% in Mountain areas.
breaks_when: Tablet drop suppression or tablet drop rates are changed
Mountain Mastery or Partial Translations is changed

claim.note: maxroll (BawLoch, 2026-09-02) and lilbotq (2026-09-28, 0:53–1:47, 2:18) on suppression; Mountain Mastery from poe2db. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.

yields.why: The waystone-quantity suffix and high drop-chance waystones keep the farm in Tier 15; the main drop, Precursor Tablets, is not in the item catalog.

claim.note: Our reading of the setup; drop rates are not measured.

waystone.notes: Tier 15, rolled to six modifiers with 90%+ waystone drop chance (Exalted Orbs), then corrupted with a Vaal Orb.

claim.note: maxroll (BawLoch, updated 2026-09-02); lilbotq (2026-09-28, 4:00): six-modifier Tier 15 waystones, corrupted.

steps: Set Jado with Partial Translations (T3); allocate Mountain Mastery and pick its Tablets bonus, which applies only in Mountain-biome maps.
Roll Tier 15 waystones to six modifiers with 90%+ waystone drop chance, then corrupt them with a Vaal Orb.
Slot three Irradiated Tablets, each with the waystone-quantity suffix and the monster-effectiveness prefix.
Pick up the Precursor Tablets the maps drop (any Precursor Tablet type, varying by map) and roll or sell them: see Craft › Roll & sell.
risks: Precursor Tablets, the main drop, are not in the item catalog: the basket shows waystones only, and tablets sell on the trade site.
Irradiated adds +1 to Monster Level (poe2db); three tablets are for their mods, not for more levels.
Which tablets drop varies from map to map (maxroll); no drop rate is claimed.
Doryani's Disengaged Safeties (T2) also makes maps Irradiated, but this setup uses Jado.
